name: Spermidine
summary: Spermidine is a polyamine (wheat germ, natto, aged cheese) sold for autophagy and longevity. The largest RCT, SmartAge (n=100, 12 months, subjective cognitive decline), found NO difference on memory endpoints or biomarkers vs placebo (PMID 35616942). Marketing leans on observational and mechanistic data; EFSA considers up to 6 mg/day food-derived spermidine safe.
description: Canonical spermidine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the SmartAge null result is given proper weight against observational data, dose boundaries (food-derived vs supplemental) are explicit, and autophagy-marker vs clinical-outcome distinctions have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: autophagy induction; polyamine metabolism; cellular senescence
